Game Overview

Airport Security 3d puts players into a simulation experience centered on become the top airport enforcer in Airport Security 3D. Uncover fake IDs and hidden contraband through immersive, vibrant gameplay. Sharpen your observation skills and make swift decisions to balance security threats with the efficient flow of travelers. Embark on a journey with each challenging, colorful level.
